purpose: Define explicit binding of DWH governance policies to exact instance/schema/resource/field/classification scopes, separate from AccessCore authorization policy.

topics.name: DWH Governance Policy Binding
topics.purpose: Define explicit binding of DWH governance policies to exact instance/schema/resource/field/classification scopes, separate from AccessCore authorization policy.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant DWH governance policy/binding has an explicit identity.
semantics.accesscore_rule: DWH governance and AccessCore authorization are orthogonal; both may need to pass.
semantics.classification_rule: Policy may consume classification/taint metadata as input.
semantics.direction_rule: Input, read/output, write, remote-share and materialization scopes may have distinct bindings.
semantics.precedence_rule: Multiple applicable policies resolve through explicit composition/precedence semantics, never file order.
semantics.default_rule: Unknown or ambiguous governed scope fails closed where protected data is involved.
semantics.ownership_rule: Policy binding does not transfer semantic ownership.

invariants.rule: DWH governance may restrict or project data according to exact schema/classification/scope policy but never creates AccessCore rights, semantic ownership or broader visibility than the underlying authorized source set.

hard_gates.condition: multiple policies resolved by file order
ambiguous protected scope allowed by default

references.purpose: DWH governance composes with, never replaces, AccessCore.
Governance targets exact resolved schema/resource identities.
